lens_perspectives.producer-propagation: Gable sections pass raw roof positions and plane data into retained enclosure polygons; samples keep host/solid IDs through assembly. Relate to original native roof point propagation rather than declaring all geometric kernel vectors defective.

lens_perspectives.admission-contracts: Host selection and station completeness are conditional. No scoped source proves admitted edge/station capacities, arbitrary public RoofFace aggregate validity or supported zero-eave wall host case.
lens_perspectives.invariant-operations: 3-bit edge and 8-bit station masks can repeat identifiers for distinct accepted stations; roof plane clipping arithmetic assumes meaningful finite normal and thickness. Preserve old aliases and conditional reachability.
lens_perspectives.aggregate-states: Edge kind, samples, weathering IDs, support interfaces, bonds, child links and drainage form coupled relations. Wall-kind filtering of tower child links is historic CONT07-F127; cleanup and native admission are partial positive evidence.

lens_perspectives.redundant-authority: Gable profiles are derived from face planes; tower child stores edge and flashing associations that a separate kind-local pass can erase. Cite CONT07-F127, not a second independent defect.
lens_perspectives.behavior-preservation: Both bodies byte-identical across 6533 and 95e; this object equality does not prove the entire current product or surrounding contract unchanged. Any future change must preserve contact rejection, pure-tower behavior, deterministic identifiers, clipping and typed errors.
lens_perspectives.enum-shapes: Wall/Tower abutment and edge kinds and Tower child use named enums. Typed kinds alone do not guarantee correct matching associations, and optional flashing/recipe or failed host is not automatically an invalid legacy mode.
lens_perspectives.derivability: The assigned production bodies contain computation, not handwritten serialization/trait boilerplate requiring an independent derive finding; no whole-repository conclusion.
lens_perspectives.type-granularity: Edge identity, sample station identity, host wall identity and solid role are related but distinct. Separate representability for each and do not merge unrelated allocator families solely because they use masks.
lens_perspectives.magic-strings: No production string-valued dispatch appears in the two assigned bodies; existing test message is diagnostic source only. Downstream audit strings are typed audit labels and require separate policy review.
lens_perspectives.magic-numbers: Lengths, contact station spacing, geometric offsets, tolerance and identity bit masks are raw values with different dimensions and roles. Examine the station range and geometry tolerance owners with error budgets; do not wrap indices, fixed sign choices or every numerical constant indiscriminately.
